messages.text:
"Create a fully playable, immersive 3D or 2D anime-style K-POP IDOL LIFE SIMULATOR.

The game should feel like a real idol's daily life, with an active world, realistic NPC interactions, unexpected events, and fun activities.

1. STARTING YOUR IDOL LIFE

- Create your own idol character.
- Customize face, hairstyle, hair color, eyes, body appearance and fashion.
- Choose your stage name and real name.
- Choose your agency.
- Start as a trainee or an already debuted idol.
- Choose whether to become a soloist or join a K-pop group.

2. TRAINING SYSTEM

Allow the player to visit different training rooms:

- Vocal training.
- Dance practice.
- Rap training.
- Acting lessons.
- Fitness and stamina training.
- Stage presence practice.

Every activity should have interactive gameplay and improve specific skills.

3. REALISTIC IDOL SCHEDULE

Create a working calendar and daily schedule:

- Monday: Dance practice.
- Tuesday: Vocal lessons.
- Wednesday: Recording.
- Thursday: Music show rehearsal.
- Friday: Music show performance.
- Saturday: Fan signing event.
- Sunday: Rest day or personal activities.

Add unexpected schedule changes and special events.

4. STAGE AND PERFORMANCE SYSTEM

- Perform on music shows.
- Attend award ceremonies.
- Perform at concerts and festivals.
- Participate in dance challenges.
- Perform live with other idols.
- Receive performance ratings.
- Gain fans and popularity depending on performance.
- Allow the player to control performances through mini-games.

5. LIVING NPC WORLD

This is VERY IMPORTANT.

Create many NPCs with different personalities:

- Fans who recognize and approach the player.
- Shy fans who ask for autographs.
- Excited fans who scream when they see you.
- Antis who criticize your performances.
- Journalists who interview you.
- Paparazzi who follow celebrities.
- Fellow idols who become friends or rivals.
- Managers who give instructions.
- Staff who help backstage.
- Other trainees who compete with you.

NPCs must have dynamic reactions depending on the player's fame, reputation, outfit, actions and previous interactions.

NPCs should walk around, talk, react and have individual dialogue.

6. RANDOM EVENTS AND IDOL PROBLEMS

Make the game exciting with unexpected situations:

- Dating rumors.
- Fake scandals.
- Viral fancams.
- Wardrobe malfunctions.
- Unexpected live broadcast incidents.
- Fans arguing online.
- Missed choreography.
- Rival idol drama.
- Friendship conflicts.
- Company announcements.
- Surprise collaborations.
- Airport crowd encounters.
- Leaked practice videos.
- Bad press and misunderstandings.

Give the player choices on how to respond. Different choices should affect popularity, reputation, friendships and career.

7. SOCIAL MEDIA SYSTEM

Create an interactive social media app inside the game:

- Post selfies and updates.
- Read fan comments.
- Receive direct messages.
- Gain followers.
- View trending hashtags.
- Experience viral posts.
- Respond to rumors.
- Read positive and negative reactions.

Generate unique comments from NPCs instead of repeating the same messages.

8. RELATIONSHIP SYSTEM

- Make friends with other idols.
- Develop rivalries.
- Build relationships with fans.
- Have conversations with NPCs.
- Invite friends to hang out.
- Attend parties and private events.
- Create meaningful storylines based on player choices.

9. IDOL STATUS

Track these statistics:

- Fame.
- Popularity.
- Talent.
- Reputation.
- Fanbase.
- Energy.
- Happiness.
- Friendship.
- Money.

10. LOCATIONS

Create explorable locations:

- Entertainment company building.
- Dance practice rooms.
- Recording studios.
- Dormitories.
- Music show venues.
- Concert stadiums.
- Shopping malls.
- Restaurants.
- Airports.
- Fan meeting venues.
- Award ceremony venues.

11. IMPORTANT GAME REQUIREMENTS

- Make the world feel alive.
- NPCs must react naturally to the player.
- Include random events and branching storylines.
- Add interactive dialogue choices.
- Make time pass during gameplay.
- Save player progress.
- Include working buttons and menus.
- Make it mobile-friendly with touchscreen controls.
- Use beautiful anime graphics and smooth animations.
- Do not make this a static interface or simple clicker game.
- Build actual playable mechanics.
- Ensure every major feature works before finishing.
- If the complete game is too large, build it in playable stages rather than displaying nonfunctional features. (2D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
